title: cenchrus sphacelatus
intro: Cenchrus sphacelatus, commonly known as the sandbur grass, is a type of flowering plant in the family Poaceae. This plant is traditionally used in various cultures for its medicinal properties, offering health benefits such as reducing inflammation, and acting as an anti-diarrheal agent. The therapeutic actions of Cenchrus sphacelatus include its ability to exhibit antimicrobial and antifungal activities, which contribute to its use in treating various infections. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids and saponins, which are responsible for its pharmacological properties.
